verdict.rationale: The only MCP-related evidence describes BILL exposing an MCP server for its own API documentation to be consumed by external AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) — this is the reverse direction of the story, which asks whether BILL Spend & Expense itself can act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows any such client-side MCP integration in the product.
